content: {"reasoning":"Authorization is required but missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; an appeal is unavailable without a denial. Similar claims had no payment success with either submission route, and the remaining deductible alone does not establish patient liability for services lacking required authorization. No listed automated action can reliably resolve the authorization barrier or establish a proper collectible balance, so specialist review is warranted before billing the patient or writing off.","action":"escalate"}
